hook.name: WallStreetTradersFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based fee hook for native ETH/token pools, charging 1–7% fees in ETH on each swap. Buy fees are taken from the ETH input in beforeSwap; sell fees from the ETH output in afterSwap. The fee rate scales with the previous swap's tick movement (realized volatility). Pool initialization is restricted to a whitelisted factory address; only exact-input swaps are permitted.
